title: Results Document Verifier
one_line: Check a results write up for claims that were asserted rather than verified, before anyone acts on it.
description: Check a results write up for claims that were asserted rather than verified, before anyone acts on it. Use when reviewing a report, before sending results to a client, or when a document says something worked.
paragraph: The failure in results documents is not lying, it is asserting. A claim that a fix worked, backed by a test that could not have failed, reads exactly like a verified claim. This skill checks each claim against its evidence and asks the one question that separates them: could this check have come out the other way.
keywords: check these results before i send them
